objectives.title: HUNT FOR ANCIENT WATER
objectives.text: Mars may have had liquid water long ago. Explore the rocks and find clues: some minerals only form when water is present.

real.text: REAL MISSION: Inspired by NASA's twin rovers Spirit and Opportunity (2004). Opportunity found hematite "blueberries", a mineral that typically forms in water.

question.text: SCIENCE QUESTION: What clues in rocks and minerals show that liquid water once existed?

objectives.title: SECRETS BENEATH THE SURFACE
objectives.text: Study how volcanoes, water and heat shaped Mars over time.
objectives.focus: FOCUS: Volcanic processes, water and heat. Activity: geological analysis.
objectives.locked: LOCKED: Complete Hunt for Ancient Water to unlock this objective.

objectives.title: SURVIVE THE RED PLANET
objectives.text: Keep your rover alive through dust, thin air and changing sunlight.
objectives.focus: FOCUS: Dust, atmosphere and energy. Activity: environment management.
